task.description:
FIX: const catalog -> var catalog in all 4 PLC test files.

BRANCH: feature/WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815

Replace ALL instances of:
  const catalog = ProcessModuleCatalog.init(alloc, &pool);
with:
  var catalog = ProcessModuleCatalog.init(alloc, &pool);

Files:
- tests/integration/plc01_module_catalog_test.zig
- tests/integration/plc02_publication_test.zig
- tests/integration/plc03_compatibility_test.zig
- tests/integration/plc04_visibility_test.zig

Reason: registerModule and publishModule take *ProcessModuleCatalog (mutable). const catalog binds *const, causing 'cast discards const qualifier'.

Verify: zig build test-integration-plc compiles.
Commit + push on feature/WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815.
